d: We are looking to hire a dynamic chief talent officer to join our company. In this role, you'll be in charge of identifying and recruiting upper-level management candidates. You'll also work with senior management to develop a talent management strategy to meet our company's business goals. To ensure success as a chief talent officer, you should have a solid knowledge of talent recruitment and be able to successfully guide employees on their path of career progression. Ultimately, a top-notch chief talent officer should have exceptional leadership skills and the ability to communicate with team members and prospective candidates.
q: Bachelor's degree in human resource management, or a similar field.
Exceptional knowledge of HR best practices and recruitment strategies.
The ability to communicate effectively with subordinate personnel and management alike.
Solid knowledge of HR tools, such as applicant tracking systems.
The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
r: Establishing a talent recruitment strategy to facilitate the hiring of prospective talent.
Coordinating recruitment events and networking with potential candidates.
Developing and organizing employee training programs.
Crafting long-term employee succession plans to ensure personnel are on track with their career progression.
Working with the HR manager to create internal promotion policies.
Assessing the company's hiring needs and updating the recruitment strategy accordingly.
Working with team leaders to evaluate personnel and create improvement plans as needed.

d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest focused Front Office professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.

As a Front Desk Manager you are responsible for the operations of Front Office with a primary focus on overall operation at Reception, ensuring end of the day procedures and subsequent reports are completed in an accurate and efficient manner.
q: You must ideally have a degree in the hospitality field with previous experience in the Front Office Department within a hotel.

You should also have fluency in both written and spoken English and an immaculate personal presentation along with the ability to solve problems effectively. Computer literate and knowledge of Opera will be highly regarded.

The ideal candidate will be well-versed with upselling and maximizing revenue techniques, always service oriented and with the passion to exceed the expectations of our guests at every turn. A positive, proactive, flexible and approachable attitude is required.

You will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment and be a great leader, who thrives in working with a multicultural team and guests alike, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: Actively elicit guest feedback and preferences, regarding hotel services and ensure action is initiated on the same to maximize guest satisfaction
Ensure maximum room revenue through upselling within stipulated guidelines, therefore optimizing the sale of room inventory, while controlling room availability in high occupancy periods
Actively involve in promoting and selling companies loyalty program, Food & Beverage events in house facilities and hotel company partners
Ensure that all accounting and auditing practices are in line with company policies, governmental requirements and check audits and registration cards before sending them to accounts
Lead and coach the team towards achieving highest level of exceptional guest service and colleague satisfaction results through the application of all corporate and property standards and policies

d: Medical Officer – Inpatient Precertification is responsible for managing the Inpatient Precertification cases while ensuring that departmental goals, timeline of activities, and compliance measures are met.
q: Bachelor’s of Pharmacy / Dentistry / Medicine / Nursing / Physiotherapist / Paramedics
01-02 years of Medical Practical Experience (reputable insurance provider, broker or a TPA experience a plus) OR Entry Level
Physically fit to carry out duties.
Legally permitted to work in the country of operations.
Physically fit to carry out duties.
Fluency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and general internet navigation and research skills.

Agency Statement Allianz Partners does not accept unsolicited CV’s or approaches from agencies. We only work with partners on our approved supplier list, under contract. Any unsolicited submission will not be considered
r: Precertification team is functional on 24/7 basis. Therefore the Medical Officer will be working on flexible shift basis as per the schedule provided by the Team Leader.
Adjudicates Cases at IP precertification level, authorizes decision within the stipulated turnaround time & with the highest quality standards in view with the policy terms and conditions

Performing complete file review with regards to the multidisciplinary notes, TPR charts, physician order’s notes, lab reports, radiology reports, drug chart sheets, consultation notes, nursing notes, progress notes, etc.
Requesting any medical documentation or finding any missing document which is essential in decision making.

Performing review of DRG Severity of Illness (SOI) in line with revision of CPT codes / ICD codes, which are being up-coded by the provider – if required discussion with the treating doctor and the medical coders.
Performing utilization review for DRG cases and FFS cases with regards to and not limited to final bill review + consumables mark ups + non covered item/services + overutilization of services.
Performing review of claims as per CPT and ICD coding guidelines in line with insurance regulators (DHA,DOH/HAAD,MOH).
Adhering to the cost containment protocols for medical management cases.

Referring cases for second opinion when deemed necessary to confirm the best mode of management – also for cost containment to lesser Negotiating factor (NF) facilities within the member’s network or option for home country treatment.
